accessToken.ui:help: Direct JWT bearer token value. This is kept for backwards compatibility.

accessTokenEnvVar.ui:help: Name of the environment variable that contains the bearer token, such as TRINO_ACCESS_TOKEN.

accessTokenFilePath.ui:help: Path to the file containing the token. The file content will be trimmed before use.

accessTokenSource.ui:help: Choose whether the token is provided directly, from an environment variable, or from a file.
